name: 3-APBT
summary: 3-APBT, also known by its former developmental code name SKF-6678 and as 3-(2-aminopropyl)benzo[β]thiophene, as well as 1-thia-α-methyltryptamine (1-thia-AMT), is a monoamine releasing agent and serotonin receptor agonist of the benzothiophene group. It is an analogue of α-methyltryptamine (AMT) in which the indole ring has been replaced with a benzothiophene ring.

pharmacology.text: 3-APBT, also known by its former developmental code name SKF-6678 and as 3-(2-aminopropyl)benzo[β]thiophene, as well as 1-thia-α-methyltryptamine (1-thia-AMT), is a monoamine releasing agent and serotonin receptor agonist of the benzothiophene group. The drug acts as a potent and well-balanced serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent (SNDRA).
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent; Serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist; Entactogen; Serotonergic psychedelic

uses.text: 3-APBT was developed by Smith, Kline & French (SKF) as a potential pharmaceutical drug in the late 1950s.
